lede: Miami carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.5 against -0.9, a 10.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Clemson +14.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Miami winning 84% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is qb room, where Miami leads Clemson by 124 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
